title: Per-tenant sealed-key attestation reconciler for cross-region retention proofs
creator: Ava Moreno
description: Build a reconciler service that collects sealed-key attestations from regional KMS/HSM gateways, verifies signatures, reconciles per-tenant retention timelines, and emits audit-ready proof bundles for compliance reporting. The reconciler should operate in two modes: streaming (near real-time reconciliation for recent events) and batch archival (daily compact bundles for long-term retention). This ticket covers design, implementation, unit/integration tests, and operational runbooks.
acceptance_criteria: Reconciler ingests sealed attestations from three regional sinks (us-west, eu-central, ap-southeast) and validates HSM signatures using stored public certificates
Per-tenant timeline view produced: sequence of key events (create, rotate, revoke) with canonical timestamps and cross-region canonicalization rules
Generate compact evidence bundles (signed digest + merkle root + provenance manifest) that satisfy auditors' requirements and match Confluence spec
End-to-end test harness that simulates network partitions and out-of-order events with reconciliation converging within SLA
Operational metrics emitted: attestations_processed_total, reconciliation_lag_seconds, bundle_generation_rate, verification_failures_count
Runbook and automated playbook for resubmitting missing attestations and triggering re-bundling are documented in Confluence
tasks: Design data model for canonical attestation timeline and merkle bundling (design doc link)
Implement ingestion adapters for KMS gateway events (gRPC/HTTP/Webhook) with idempotency tokens
Verification library: HSM signature verification, certificate rotation support, CRL/OCSP checks
Reconciliation engine: conflict resolution, event ordering, tombstone handling for revocations
Bundle generator: merkle tree builder, signed manifest creator, S3 archival + retention tags
Daily batch job and streaming worker orchestration (Kubernetes Cron + long-running consumer)
Integration tests: multi-region simulator, fault injection, and expiry/retention policy enforcement
Observability: dashboards, alerts, and exploratory queries for auditors
Runbook: step-by-step for manual re-run, evidence regeneration, and emergency key revocation handling
updates: 2025-02-12 - Created ticket and sketched initial data model during infra sync; flagged as P1 due to upcoming audit cadence
2025-02-18 - PO review with Compliance: clarified that manifest must include per-bundle signer certificate chain and canonical timezone normalization
2025-02-21 - Implemented prototype verifier for ECDSA signatures and added CRL check; opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/9123
2025-02-25 - Added batch bundling sketch for object lifecycle tagging and retention-compatible archive format; started integration tests for out-of-order events
notes: Key design decisions: 1) use canonical UTC timestamps with source-region tag to avoid ambiguous local-time retention edges; 2) bundle manifests must include HSM signer certificate chains and per-tenant policy references; 3) reconciliation will prefer highest-sequence-number per-key with tombstones for revocations. Next steps: finish design doc, complete verifier unit tests, and schedule compliance review meeting.
